linux-flatpak.reason: The pinned repository provides libretro and desktop build files but no Retro8 Flatpak manifest or verified Flatpak package.
evidence: source:README.md describes compilation and RetroArch-core use but no Flatpak target @ddc06a14
source:repository tree contains no Flatpak manifest @ddc06a14

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not invent a Retro8 controller profile: the pinned libretro core exposes runtime RetroPad callbacks but no persistent host-controller mapping grammar; RetroArch configuration and device profiles are frontend-owned.

notes: Retro8 is an open-source PICO-8 reimplementation/core. The core reports p8/png content and fixed runtime descriptors, but does not implement serialized state or external BIOS/key loading. RetroArch frontend runtime and package behavior were not verified.
